summary: Reviewed all prior Métis 2.0 execution artifacts: metis-2.0-exec (CURRENT.md, 29-row BLOCKERS.md, OWNER-DECISIONS.md, TASK-001..005, TASK-027 reconcile.md, WINDOWS-SIGNING research) and the previously-unreferenced metis-r11-work worktree. Verdict: TASK-001 through TASK-005 are all PARTIAL — never NOT_STARTED, never fully DONE — with designs/registers that are almost always implementation-ready while the actual gate is an owner decision or an external account/hardware dependency, not missing engineering effort. TASK-027/028.A (the next scheduled work) has zero code changes but a fully-specified, file:line-cited, test-ID-mapped defect backlog (11 right-edge-dock defects) ready to execute once the shipping-line decision lands. Windows signing is decision-ready (6 priced/timed routes) but blocked on entity choice + procurement. Of the 29 blockers, 10 are pure OWNER-ONLY, 6 are ACCOUNT/EXTERNAL, 7 are pure ENGINEERING-SOLVABLE-NOW, and 6 are compound (owner decision gates otherwise-ready engineering) — 13 of 29 have an engineering-doable component that can proceed in parallel with the ask to Tony. The single most important new finding: metis-r11-work is a separate, undocumented, uncommitted worktree containing a fully-green (typecheck/check:bugs/6734-test-suite/proxy/operator all PASS), 13-file, tested-and-reviewed-quality fix set — including one CRITICAL, previously-untracked defect (MQA-348: unit tests were writing into and hanging on the developer's real OneDrive meeting-notes folder), a partial code-level answer to blocker #5 (Cloudflare AI-Gateway privacy enforcement, fail-closed), and a fix for the same synchronous-media-throw defect class (C2) that reconcile.md documents as already fixed on main in a sibling file but is still unfixed in onboarding-hero-video.ts. This fix set is not referenced anywhere in metis-2.0-exec's own tracking and should be triaged/merged rather than re-derived. Sanitization blocker #26 is now half-resolved (the .wrangler account-ID cache is gone) but the personal-email masking at service-register.md:29,30,53 is still outstanding (confirmed via masked regex scan, no PII reproduced here). Full evidence, file:line citations, and the 30-item requirements list are in the linked report.
